title: Beyond Binary Classification: Detecting Fine-Grained Sexism in Social Media Videos

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-only and multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs) using zero-shot prompting to detect and classify Spanish social media videos into fine-grained sexism categories, including gender stereotypes, denial of inequality, and objectification.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Assessing models' ability to detect discrimination against the LGBTQ+ community (including homophobia and transphobia) as a specific sub-category within a multi-label, fine-grained sexism detection taxonomy applied to social media videos.
